ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 92% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 8% high-intensity (white) pixels on visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity base field; localized high-intensity pixel clusters appearing as three linear segments on the lower-left lobe and multiple stippled circular clusters on the central and right lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with a measured interior angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged linear boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel variations (serrations) along the entire visible trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward toward pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of small, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters distributed across the right fluke lobe and central fluke area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, roughly horizontal high-intensity linear pixel streaks located in the lower-left quadrant of the visible ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of distinct white linear scarring on the left lobe and multiple small circular white marks (potential parasitic or barnacle scarring) on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct high-contrast avian-shaped pixel clusters (birds) in flight, one of which is partially occluding the background/trailing edge interface of the right fluke tip.
